Now I have a better understanding of what needs to be done. Let me understand the requirements again:

1. [R1] The glom_cli tool must accept python-full format specifications that include arbitrary Python expressions rather than just AST literals. It must also support loading target data from Python files or strings using the python-full format.
2. [R2] The public API must expose the Merge spec and merge convenience function for combining iterables of mappings into a single mapping. Additionally, Spec instances used in key positions of default dict/mapping specs must evaluate their contents to enable dynamic key generation.

The release must also expose these public names: Auto, Fill, Invoke, Iter, Let, ROOT.
